cards.front: Can you tell me about yourself?
cards.speakText: Can you tell me about yourself?
cards.backContent: Sure! I think I’m a _____ and _____ person.
cards.extra1: Useful words: sociable • hardworking • creative • responsible • independent • honest • shy • humorous • supportive • patient
cards.example: Sure! I think I’m a sociable and responsible person.

cards.front: What do you usually do in your free time?
cards.speakText: What do you usually do in your free time?
cards.extra1: Useful chunks: listen to music • play sports • read books • watch videos • go out with friends • help my family
cards.example: Well, I usually listen to music because it helps me relax.

cards.backContent: Because it helps me _____ and shows _____.
cards.extra1: Useful chunks: relax • learn new things • stay healthy • feel happy • be creative • my personality • my interests
cards.example: Because it helps me relax and shows my interest in music.

cards.front: What’s something special about your personality?
cards.speakText: What’s something special about your personality?
cards.extra1: Add one detail: because I… / I usually… / My friends say I’m…
cards.example: I’d say I’m quite helpful because I like supporting my friends.
